CFrameSerializer.luau.description: Optimized these functions for speed as well as preserving fidality. In the future, use Roblox's orthogonal angle format. Public entry points include `CFrameSerializer.outputRotationAzure`, `CFrameSerializer.toJSONString`, `CFrameSerializer.isRotationAzure`, `CFrameSerializer.fromJSONString`, `CFrameSerializer.readPosition`, `CFrameSerializer.readRotationAzure`.

CFrameUtils.luau.description: Useful utility functions involving CFrame values. Public entry points include `CFrameUtils.lookAt`, `CFrameUtils.cframeFromTo`, `CFrameUtils.redirectLocalAxis`, `CFrameUtils.axisAngleToCFrame`, `CFrameUtils.fromUpRight`, `CFrameUtils.scalePosition`, `reflect`, `CFrameUtils.mirror`.

getRotationInXZPlane.luau.description: Utility function to get rotation in the XZ plane. Public entry points include `getRotationInXZPlane`.
